subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sunny
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cloudy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sunny"** means bright with sunlight; characterized by sunshine. (धूपदार)

 
 
• **Example: **It was a **sunny** day, perfect for a picnic in the park.
 
 
 
• **"Cloudy" **refers to weather conditions where the sky is covered with clouds; it is the opposite of sunny. (बादलों से भरा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The sky was **cloudy**, and it looked like it might rain soon.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Sunny' **is **'Cloudy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brilliant **(उज्ज्वल): Exceptionally bright or radiant.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **brilliant **smile lit up the room.
 
 
 
• **Bright **(चमकदार): Emitting or reflecting light; shining.
 
 
• **Example: **The **bright **lights of the city were visible from miles away.
 
 
 
• **Fair** (साफ़): Light in colour; not dark.
 
 
• **Example:** She has **fair **skin that easily burns in the sun.
